goal: Add a Settings Launch at login control so people can start Bronze when this Mac logs in and do not have to remember to open it.
outcome: Settings General shows a labeled Launch at login checkbox bound to SettingsV1.general.launchAtLogin (default false, explicit consent). Saving, resetting, or starting Bronze applies that intent through SMAppService.mainApp register/unregister. Persist the user choice even when registration needs Login Items approval or the current debug binary is not a .app. Surface enabled, notRegistered, requiresApproval, or unavailable honestly — never silently succeed. Cargo tests never call live SMAppService. Event-tap does not touch login items. ADR-002, ADR-009, and ADR-018 stay Proposed. Do not claim QUEUE-ATTACHMENTS-*.

requirements.statement: Field is SettingsV1.general.launchAtLogin, bool, default false. Persist through save_settings_v1 / replace_settings / reset. Apply on save, reset field/group/all, and native start.

macOS 13+ apply uses ServiceManagement.SMAppService.mainApp register() / unregister() / status. Map status to enabled, notRegistered, requiresApproval, notFound, or unavailable. Persist the checkbox even when register returns requiresApproval or notFound.
Unbundled tauri dev and missing SMAppService must not pretend the login item is on. Return unavailable or notFound. Cargo tests never invoke live SMAppService.register or unregister.
Event-tap callbacks must not contain SMAppService, login item, register, unregister, or launch-at-login apply. They must not touch AX, DB, windows, clipboard, or login items.

Settings uses a real labeled checkbox (HIG/WCAG), not a clickable div, plus circled-i info like other General titles. Locale catalog only (en, nl, fr, de, es, it). No sentence concatenation. HTML fallback matches en.

Do not claim QUEUE-ATTACHMENTS-RUST or other QUEUE-ATTACHMENTS-*. Do not resume bmad-loop 6a79. ADR-002, ADR-009, and ADR-018 stay Proposed. ADR-019 stays Proposed. No Cooper/Copper copy. No runtime network.
Checking Launch at login persists general.launchAtLogin true and calls register; unchecking persists false and calls unregister. Reset returns false and unregisters.
A status of requiresApproval or notFound does not flip the stored checkbox back to off. Tests cover status mapping without live SMAppService.
